sources.quote: the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approved source for BR-220 (PLT-BEI, CUST-AUR) is SUP-B. There is no approval for SUP-C on this part. The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored company standing only and did not add a part approval. Saying that quality approved Chisone does not cover BR-220.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5, so it lacks the capability. Nothing newer shows 6082-T6 qualification. The 2026-11-06 re-audit did not change part approvals.

findings.key: 8D cracking on Chisone 6082 material (no issue id given)

sources.quote: The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: The supplier still has an open 8D on 6082 material, which is the alloy family of BR-220. It was confirmed open on 2026-11-06, after the earlier rejection. The documents give no issue id, so the key is a description.
